Based on: E-513

Buyer:
Hi,
We want to purchase 25 boxes of handmade porcelain planters at $42 per box.
Can you extend payment terms of net 60 days so we have two months to pay?

Seller:
Hi,
We have 25 boxes of porcelain planters at $42 each.
However, we cannot do net 60 days as waiting two months creates too much unpaid balance risk.
The best we can offer is net 14 days, with $18 shipping.

Buyer:
Fair enough, we understand.
Net 14 days works for us on the 25 boxes at $42 each.
Please send the bill.
